company.name: Urban Point
company.shortDescription: Urban Point is an incentive company that offers lifestyle guide and data-driven insights for merchants to engage with customers.
company.description: Urban Point provides a subscription-based platform offering over 4,000 monthly renewing deals and discounts on dining, food delivery, beauty, health, and other activities. The service aims to help users save money on everyday purchases in a fun and simple way. Urban Point collaborates with various local businesses to negotiate valuable offers for its subscribers. The platform is accessible to Ooredoo Postpaid plan users for free, enhancing its reach and usability.
